notes: Walks the circular sentinel-based list (aClass348_Sub42_1647.aClass348_Sub42_7063 chain) counting nodes until it loops back to the sentinel, starting the count at initialCount. MediaStreamClient.kt calls .method1002(0) on two different iterators and adds/subtracts the results - i.e. classic list-length/size usage, always seeded with 0 at observed call sites.

Non-destructive forward cursor step: returns the node currently pointed to by the internal cursor (aClass348_Sub42_1652), advances the cursor to that node's next pointer (or nulls it out if back at the sentinel/empty), without unlinking anything. Used in a first()/next() enumeration idiom paired with method1011 across many call sites (LruByteCache, ContactList, GlArrayBufferObject, ChatCommandProcessor, direct/Direct3dModel, etc.): 'var x = iter.method1011(...); while (x != null) { ...; x = iter.method1003(...) }'. decoy must be > 41 or the step is skipped and null returned.

Inserts node immediately before the sentinel (i.e. at the tail of the circular list, since the sentinel's 'prev' always points at the current last element), unlinking it from any prior list first if it was already linked. When link is true the neighboring nodes' pointers are also updated to complete the splice; the false branch only sets the node's own prev/next fields without fixing up neighbors, which looks like a broken/dead half-insert - every observed call site (CacheLruCache, LruByteCache, ContactList) passes link=true, so this path may never really execute as a genuine 'insert' in practice.

Reads the head of the list (sentinel.aClass348_Sub42_7063, i.e. the oldest/first-inserted still-linked node since method1005 inserts at the tail), returns null if the list is empty (head == sentinel), otherwise unlinks that node (via HashLinkedListNode.method3162) and returns it - a classic FIFO/LRU 'pop oldest' dequeue operation. Used by CacheLruCache.kt and LruByteCache.kt for cache eviction. decoy nulls the cursor field when != 20 (a dead/no-op reset in all observed call sites, which pass 20 or an xor'd expression).

Repeatedly reads and unlinks the list head until it loops back to the sentinel (i.e. removes every node), then resets the cursor to null. Only runs its real body when decoy == 2110355138, which is exactly what every observed call site passes (CacheLruCache, CalendarUtil, direct/Direct3dModel, LruByteCache with an xor'd expression reducing to the same constant) - a full-list clear/reset operation.

Reads the head of the list (sentinel.aClass348_Sub42_7063) without unlinking it, returns null (and clears the cursor) if the list is empty, otherwise sets the internal cursor to the head's next pointer and returns the head node - establishes the starting point for the first()/next() enumeration idiom continued by method1003. Used at the start of iteration loops across LruByteCache, ContactList, GlArrayBufferObject, ChatCommandProcessor, direct/Direct3dModel, HslAdjustTextureNode, HudTabPanel, etc. decoy is call-site-specific but doesn't appear to gate any branch in the body (pure counter/no-op param here).
